generalCriterionList.description: A valid copy of KPWD/PWD/KNNL registration certificate (As above mentioned).
The requisite Earnest Money Deposit in e-cash
Valid EPF registration certificate and latest paid challan.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Latest Copy of Income Tax Return filed for the Financial Year 2025-26 (Assessment Year 2026-27) mentioning the PAN. Or latest.
IT Permanent Account Number (PAN) Card of the bidder, issued by Income Tax Department.

The Intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one any Construction work of value not less than 25% of the amount put to tender during last five years reckoned back from 2025-26.(i.e. work executed during, 2021-22 2022-23 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26 will be considered). The work done certificate should be issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned division/ equivalent officer/ next higher officer. (For Sl No,7,8,9 & 10 Works)

The bidder should have achieved in at least one financial years a minimum financial turn-over of not less than amount put to tender in last five years. Audited balance sheet is to be uploaded along with the technical bid. Audited balance sheet for One financial years in which not less than amount put to tender, turn-over achieved, out of 2021-22 2022-23 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26. is to be uploaded with the technical bid. The cost will be updated to the present value by the giving weight age of 10% each year. If the work is completed prior to the year 2025-26.(For Sl No,7,8,9 & 10 Works)

Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant Document certifying his/her status as Schedule castes or Schedule Tribe CAT I and CAT IIA other reserved category as prescribed above table(For Sl No,7,8,9 & 10 Works)
The contractor belonging to Schedule castes or Schedule Tribe, CAT I and CAT IIA shall be Domicile of state Of Karnataka for more than 10 years as prescribed above table (For Sl No,7,8,9 & 10 Works)

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Removal of silt and Repairs of IP side breached Embankment and Service road of Right bank canal of Amarja Project due to Heavy rain in the Aland and Afzalpur taluka kalaburgi dist (from CH 30.00 to 42.00 km)

itemList.description: Clearing and grubbing road land including uprooting rank vegetation, grass, bushes, shrubs, saplings and trees girth up to 300 mm, removal of stumps of trees cut earlier and disposal of unserviceable materials and stacking of serviceable material to be used or auctioned, including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness
Cutting and removing jauliflora bushes up to 1.50 m girth excluding removal of stumps and including burning or disposing off the materials as directed with all lead and all lifts.

Excavation and removal of silt and silt mixed with sand from canal bed in dry condition including disposing off the same in spoil bank or on the canal embankment in layers as directed etc., completed with all lead and all lifts dry condition .

De-silting of Feeder Channel/Canal in dry condition  by excavating the deposited bed material and  disposing off  the  same  by stacking/ formation of Embankment or as directed including  cost  of  all  machinery, labour & all necessary works as directed and complete as per specification.

Loosening, leveling and Compacting original ground supporting embankment to facilitate placement of first layer of embankment, scarified to a depth of 150 mm, mixed with water at OMC and then compacted by rolling so as to achieve minimum dry density as given in Table 300-2 for embankment construction

Construction Embankment by excavating the available approved Gravel/Murrum deposited at a place or borrow pits during or prior excavation with all lifts and lead, transportation to site, speading grading to required slope and compacting to meet the requirement completes as per specifications, including cost of labour,rolling,water,all materials,usage& all other appurtenaces required to comlete the work.
Maintenance of Hume pipe Culvert by way of Clearing, Cleaning, Erosion repair, repairs to cracks, parapet wall and protection work as per drawing and technical specification Clause 1909.

Kilometre Stone    ( Ordinary kilometer stone precast )    Reinforced cement concrete M15grade kilometre stone of standard design as per IRC:8-1980, fixing in position including painting and printing etc
